issues: Document is a phytosanitary-lab accreditation scope (Center for Phytosanitary Expertise, Nizhny Novgorod), not an FSA sample with ТР ТС columns; no ТР ТС / раздел section headings occur anywhere, so tr_section is null for every row per rules. Section headings found are method-category headings (Отбор проб (образцов); Энтомологические/Нематологические/Микологические исследования; Микробиологические и молекулярно-генетические исследования with subsections Нематоды/Грибы/Бактерии и фитоплазмы/Вирусы и вироиды; Гербологические исследования) and were deliberately NOT used as tr_section per the rule against substituting non-ТР-ТС headings. All 75 pages rendered upright at 150dpi (landscape A4, no rotation needed) and read visually page by page. Where a numbered table row listed multiple object types (col 3) together with multiple indicator species (col 6), each object/species combination was expanded per the 'one row per indicator' rule; for rows where object and species could not be reliably paired 1:1 (e.g. row 18, row 32), the object field was set to the concatenation of all listed object types for that numbered row rather than guessing a pairing. All qualitative indicators in this document use 'Выявлен / Не выявлен' as the range (put in range_from, range_to/unit null) rather than numeric ranges; the entire document contains no numeric measurement ranges. Row 1 and Row 2 (sampling standards) list many distinct object types under one indicator ('Отбор проб (образцов)') with per-object ОКПД2/ТН ВЭД codes; these were split into one JSON row per object to preserve the code correspondence.
